These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the SharpJob mobile application ("the App"), operated by Player99 Inc. ("we," "our," or "us"). By downloading, accessing, or using the App, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

1. What SharpJob Is

SharpJob is an independent job listing platform that aggregates and displays job vacancies from South African employers, including publicly available government vacancy information sourced from the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA). SharpJob does not process job applications directly — all applications are submitted through each employer's own official application channel, external to the App.

2. No Account Required

SharpJob currently does not require you to create an account or log in. Any information you save within the App (such as bookmarked jobs or in-progress application notes) is stored locally on your device and is not transmitted to or stored on our servers.

3. Accuracy of Listings

We make reasonable efforts to display job listings accurately and to keep information up to date. However, job listings — including salary ranges, closing dates, and application requirements — originate from third-party employers and official government sources, and we cannot guarantee their accuracy, completeness, or continued availability. Listings may close, change, or be filled without notice from the original source before we are able to update the App.

4. Third-Party Links and Applications

The App contains links to external websites operated by employers, government departments, and provincial application portals. When you tap "Apply," you leave the App and are subject to the terms, privacy practices, and application processes of that third party. We are not responsible for the content, accuracy, or conduct of any third-party site, nor for the outcome of any job application you submit through them.

5. No Affiliation with Government Entities

SharpJob is an independent platform and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially representing any government department or entity. Government job listings are aggregated from publicly available official sources for informational and convenience purposes only.
